name: ui-change
use_for: Any visible UI change: show before and after.
guide:
Use this for any change a person can see on screen.

- **summary**: one or two sentences on what changed and why. Lead with the effect, not the code.
- **before** / **after**: screenshots of the same screen at the same size, so the slider lines up. PNG is fine; the CLI converts to WebP.
- **demo**: a short recording (under 30 s) when the change involves motion or several steps.
- **changes**: one bullet per visible change.
- **risks**: anything that could look or behave worse, e.g. small screens or dark mode.

Tips: crop to the part that changed; take both shots with the same data so only your change differs.

slots.name: summary
slots.label: Summary
slots.hint: What changed and why, in 1-2 sentences

slots.name: after
slots.label: After
slots.hint: Screenshot after the change, same size as before

slots.name: demo
slots.label: Demo
slots.hint: Short recording of the change in use

slots.name: risks
slots.label: Risks
slots.hint: What could look or work worse

example.summary: Promo code field now sits below the order total, so checkout is one step instead of two.
changes: Promo field moved under the total
risks: On screens under 360 px the total wraps to two lines
